summary: The implementation successfully addresses all three requirements (REQ-55, REQ-56, REQ-57) by creating a ValidationMetrics component, updating LiveMonitor to include it, and enhancing useFocusMonitor with detailed switching history. All acceptance criteria appear to be satisfied based on the diff evidence.

hallucinated_features.description: Mock/fallback data generation in LiveMonitor when backend data is unavailable
hallucinated_features.reason: The LiveMonitor.tsx calculates metrics with fallback mock data (switchCount: 3, switchesPerMinute: 0.5, switchesPerHour: 8) when activityData is unavailable. This fallback behavior was not requested in the BuildRequest.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend data fetching and calculation logic in LiveMonitor
hallucinated_features.reason: LiveMonitor.tsx includes logic to fetch activityData from backend and calculate metrics from recent scores (last 5 minutes), slicing data and averaging. The BuildRequest only asked to display metrics from the hook, not to independently fetch and calculate from backend data.

hallucinated_features.description: Distraction score formula implementation in ValidationMetrics component
hallucinated_features.reason: The ValidationMetrics component implements a specific distraction score calculation formula (Score = base + switches × 0.5 multiplier). The BuildRequest requested displaying the calculation breakdown but did not specify implementing or defining the formula itself in this component.
